verdict.rationale: Billing granularity is a fair question for a cloud application platform like Render, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents billing by active compute time, scale-to-zero, or per-use pricing. Load-based autoscaling and community pricing comments are adjacent and do not show that idle time goes unbilled.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can pay only for active compute time rather than idle wall-clock time
